name: Darker than Darkness
descriptionTemplate: {Team Unique}: At the start of exploration, add 1 {Fall into Night} card to the deck.
lore:
O you who sleep in darkness, hear my call.
The world you once knew is besieged by a darkness called Oblivion. Silent chaos is devouring every trace of your existence.
From the distant past, before land was born, to this very moment—
through the three centuries and more since the Great Flood, the black tide has reached everywhere and spared nothing.
It washes over your soul, leaving shining drops of silver.
They are the light that guides the way.
We pray for your awakening, for your bond with those who lead the way.
We pray that the radiance of your soul may become the bedrock of civilization—a foundation that endures beyond darkness, unto immortality.
May the Silver Key guide us.
